caption: The drawing depicts seven rectangular swatches of fabric patterns arranged in two roughly horizontal layers against a beige or off-white background. From left to right, the top row contains: a tall, narrow green rectangle with vertical black lines and small white floral motifs; a medium blue square with white and light blue abstract shapes and swirls; a square with a white background and alternating vertical and horizontal lines in pink and black, with pink flower-like shapes at the intersections; and a tall, narrow rectangle with a red background and irregular black cracked lines. The bottom row contains: a square with a white background and yellow and brown grid lines; a central vertical rectangle with a beige base and brown crisscrossed diagonal lines creating a diamond pattern; and a square with a black background featuring a green and orange checkered pattern with some yellow highlights. The artist’s signature and the year, written in red, are located below the bottom-left swatch.
title: Quilt Patches
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
